title: Sales/CS request condenser and impact-scan for enterprise asks
creator: Alex Kim
description: Build a lightweight 'condenser' process and template that lets Sales/CS submit grouped enterprise feature requests (non-bug) and receive a first-pass impact and effort scan from PMs within 3 business days. Goal is to reduce duplicate asks, surface common solution patterns, and provide a consistent initial go/no-go and rough economic direction to account teams.
background: Repeatedly, CS and Sales send long lists of account-specific asks. PMs spend ad-hoc time triaging the ask bundles; engineering scope is inconsistent; customers get mixed signals. Existing intake artifacts are detailed but heavy — we need a pragmatic fast-path for enterprise signals so we can: 1) avoid duplicate work, 2) produce a repeatable estimate of engineering effort and ROI sensitivity, and 3) indicate tentative release lanes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Template form (one-pager) adopted by Sales/CS and available in Drive/Confluence; 2) PM Triage guide that results in a documented decision (Consolidate / Candidate / Needs Research / Decline) within 3 business days for 80% of submissions; 3) A sample of 10 historical enterprise asks processed through the new flow with time-to-triage and disposition recorded; 4) Handoff checklist to Solutions Eng + Eng leads created.
implementation_notes:
- Create a short intake template (3 fields for value hypothesis, UA, rough usage, constraints) + optional attachments.
- Define 3-level effort bands (Small: 1-2 wk, Medium: 2-6 wk, Large: >6 wk).
- Define 3-level business impact bands (Low/Medium/High) with criteria (customer count, revenue signal, regulatory need).
- Provide a rubric for when to route to Dedicated/Private tracks.
- Implement a triage kanban in Linear with automated labels and a templated comment response.
- Pilot with three AE/CS pods for 3 weeks and gather metrics.
- Deliverables: intake template, triage rubrics, PM quick-scan checklist, pilot readout.

risks:
- Sales may not adopt without a crisp easy-to-fill template.
- Initial triage may be noisy — need to track false positives.
- If we over-commit effort banding, engineering will push back on accuracy.
next_steps: 1) Finalize template and embed in Sales playbook (owner: Priya). 2) Create Linear kanban and labels (owner: Jordan/Eng). 3) Run 3-week pilot and collect: time-to-triage, disposition accuracy, AE satisfaction. 4) Iterate and expand rollout.
notes_for_reviewers: Please review the draft intake template in Drive and the triage rubric table. Looking for: clear value signals, minimal mandatory fields, and whether the effort bands align with eng expectations. PM/Eng signoff required before pilot.
